source.note: The commit that adds this file. Not installed; deploy through the normal release path first.

supported.accounts: add, login (interactive agy: Google OAuth URL + pasted code), refresh, rename, remove/restore, delete (history preserved)
supported.sessions: new and resume in HERDR or a terminal (agy --conversation UUID; yolo adds --dangerously-skip-permissions)
supported.headless: api send mode resume (stopped) and new: agy -p= stream-json stdin, --print-timeout, auth-gated
supported.terminal_input: submit/queue/steer typed into a verified HERDR pane; queue/steer key chosen by queuedMessages (Enter or alt+m)

unsupported.usage: agy shows quota only in its interactive /usage view
unsupported.archive_delete: agy deletes conversations only from its /resume picker

client_steps: Show antigravity accounts and sessions like Gemini ones; hide auth-mode, API-key and live-steering items.
Use capabilities and capability_reasons per row; never infer support from the provider id.
Treat delivery_unknown as possibly delivered; never resend.

deployment.note: Requires an operator-authorized release; the live root was not touched.
